findings.description: Pierre Henri Désobry's wife was Clemence Sauselle. The tree currently records no spouse for him, though it records two children (Philibert b. 1800, Jean Baptiste Aimé b. 1813).
supporting_sources: France, Nord, Parish and Civil Registration, 1524-1893 — death registration, 8 Sep 1809, Pecquencourt, for Julien Désobri, naming parents Pierre Henri Désobri and Clemence Sauselle

findings.description: Pierre Henri Désobry and Clemence Sauselle had a son, Julien Désobri, born 1808 and died in infancy 7 September 1809 in Pecquencourt — between the tree's two known children (Philibert b. 1800, Jean Baptiste Aimé b. 1813).
supporting_sources: France, Nord, Parish and Civil Registration, 1524-1893 — death registration, 8 Sep 1809, Pecquencourt
